mr.mod.national_glory.name: National Reclamation Doctrine
mr.mod.national_glory.desc: Joint offensive doctrine, mobilized reserves, and strategic planning for a campaign to reunite the divided homeland.
mr.mod.strait_armada.name: Reclamation Sealift Armada
mr.mod.strait_armada.desc: Expanded naval slipways, fast landing flotillas, and forward maritime logistics for contested amphibious crossings.
mr.mod.mainland_underground.name: Homeland Civic Underground
mr.mod.mainland_underground.desc: Clandestine broadcasts, local civic cells, and sympathetic defector networks awaiting a liberation offensive.
mr.mod.return_momentum.name: Homeland Reclamation Momentum
mr.mod.return_momentum.desc: A secured foothold in the disputed homeland has ignited a liberation offensive, drawing volunteers and defectors to the banner.
mr.mod.regime_shock.name: Foothold Regime Shock
mr.mod.regime_shock.desc: Kindred liberation forces have broken into core territory, rattling regime morale and sparking unrest across the provinces.
mr.dec.national_glory.name: Adopt National Reclamation Doctrine
mr.dec.national_glory.desc: Reorient the armed forces from static defence to homeland reclamation, mobilizing reserves and an offensive strike doctrine.
mr.dec.national_glory.unavail: Requires an unreclaimed larger kindred rival holding homeland claims and at least 45% stability.
mr.dec.strait_armada.name: Expand Reclamation Sealift Armada
mr.dec.strait_armada.desc: Commission fast landing craft, amphibious escorts, and port logistics to carry successive divisions across contested waters.
mr.dec.strait_armada.unavail: Requires an unreclaimed larger kindred rival holding homeland claims and at least 40% stability.
mr.dec.mainland_underground.name: Activate Homeland Underground
mr.dec.mainland_underground.desc: Fund covert civic networks and sympathetic officers across contested homeland provinces to rally behind an offensive.
mr.dec.mainland_underground.unavail: Requires an unreclaimed larger kindred rival holding homeland claims and at least 40% stability.
mr.ev.glory_council.title: The Homeland Reclamation Council
mr.ev.glory_council.desc: Senior planners in the capital present a bold blueprint to reunite the divided nation: a concentrated spearhead timed to a crisis inside the larger rival.
mr.ev.glory_council.con1: Mobilizes trained reserves, raises offensive doctrine, and prepares the reclamation offensive.
mr.ev.glory_council.opt2: Focus on fleets and expeditionary logistics first
mr.ev.glory_council.con2: Strengthens fleet readiness and logistics while keeping the home front calm.
mr.ev.strait_window.title: Across the Divide: The Hour Has Come
mr.ev.strait_window.desc: With war underway for national reunification, state broadcasters transmit directly into the contested homeland calling on citizens and garrisons to welcome the returning republic.
mr.ev.strait_window.opt1: Throw everything into the reclamation offensive
mr.ev.strait_window.con1: Mobilizes volunteers and surges offensive momentum across the front.
mr.ev.strait_window.opt2: Coordinate underground cells and fleet resupply
mr.ev.strait_window.con2: Refills fleet stores and deepens local underground support.
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.title: Restlessness in the Contested Provinces
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.desc: Wartime strain and broadcasts from a kindred rival across the divide are stirring quiet defiance in key provincial cities.
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.con1: Keeps the treasury intact, but deepens stability loss and regional radicalism.
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.opt2: Dispatch emergency subsidies to restless provinces
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.con2: Draws public funds and dampens war enthusiasm to calm the cities.
